facts.text: Serve the mains when Carol and Monica crash into the Khan family home in Jersey City.
facts.why: Wikipedia's plot says Danvers is transported to Kamala's house when the three swap places, and the three then fight the Kree there. It does not say Monica crashes in as well, so who lands where is unclear. The same text is printed on the card as the mess call.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Carol swaps into the Khan family home in Jersey City.

vibe.verdict: Looks the part, with a dark S.A.B.E.R. galley and the Khan family food and Goose jokes in the right places; the writing could use more of Kamala's fan energy.
missing: Goose and the Flerkitten litter swallowing the crew (evacuation)
Aladna, where everyone speaks in song (Prince Yan)
Kamala's fan wall of Captain Marvel art
The three swapping places mid-fight in the Khan kitchen
ideas: Swap the 'Goose's cheddar fish crackers' note for 'Flerkitten rations, swallowed whole'.
Swap 'Space station popcorn' note for an Aladna singing-menu joke.
Swap the 'Badge' tag line 'Nick Fury approves' for 'Fury, still short a cat'.
Add Kamala's fan wall as a decorative stamp on the sweets page.
